messages:
Aya: Heads up — nightly eval (run 1965432000) shows a regression after the v12 weight + tokenizer update. Overall QA pass rate down ~8% vs v11 on the main prompt set.
Miguel: ugh. Which slices are worst? any single prompt failing a lot or many small drops?
Aya: Mostly few-shot code completions and short-answer factuals. Observed token alignment shifts in examples that rely on exact substring matches.
Priya: Can you paste the failing example?
Aya: Sure — example from prompt-id: core_factual_042. With v11 the model returns the exact span; with v12 it inserts a leading space and shifts offsets, so our checker marks it wrong.
Dan: That sounds like a tokenizer offset/normalization change rather than pure weight regression. Did crate the tokenizer artifacts change during the deploy?
Zoe: We updated the tokenizer merges file and applied 4-bit quantization tuning at the same time in the bring-up. Could be an interaction.
Priya: @Zoe can you confirm the tokenizer version hash used in the canary?
Zoe: Tokenizer hash: tknr_2026_04_01_ab9c. We also used quant-profile: q8_heuristic_v2 -> but then tried q4_a2 in the canary matrix for latency tests.
Miguel: Important: the nightly eval uses deterministic detokenize+span matcher — if token offsets shift by whitespace or subtokens we get false negatives. Need to reproduce locally with the same detokenizer config.
Aya: Repro steps I used:
```
# reproduce minimal
from rl_eval import run_single
run_single(model='v12-prod', prompt_id='core_factual_042', seed=42, detokenize='standard')
```
Aya: With v11 that yields "Paris" at offsets 12-17. With v12 yields " Paris" at 11-17 (leading space).
Dan: Can you run the same with the on-disk tokenizer from the model package versus the rollout artifact? sometimes packaging strips normalization flags.
Zoe: I already tried on-disk vs package: package had normalization flag NFKC disabled accidentally. Fixing that in a patch helped some samples but not the quantized runs.
Priya: So two variables: tokenizer normalization + quantization. We should isolate. Can we run v12 weights with v11 tokenizer (and same detokenize) without quant to see if offsets persist?
Miguel: Also check KV-cache prefix handling — a shifted subtoken boundary early in sequence can cascade for few-shot prompts.
Aya: Good call. I ran v12 weights, v11 tokenizer, no quant (float32) — offsets match v11. So primary issue is tokenizer normalization change.
Zoe: Ok that's actionable. But I still see a small degradation in BLEU-ish metrics for code completions when using q4_a2 quant — separate issue.
Dan: For triage plan: 1) Roll tokenizer normalization flag back in canary and re-run nightly; 2) Run quant ablation: v12 + v11 tokenization + q8/q4; 3) If quant causes quality drop, try alternative quant kernels or tuned per-layer scale.
Priya: Assigning owners: Zoe takes tokenizer rollback and canary; Miguel takes quant ablation matrix and reproducer harness; Aya owns regression ticket and updates failing prompt examples.
Zoe: On it. I'll push a rollback artifact before EOD and kick a targeted nightly.
deploy-bot: nightly-eval/1965432000: rerun scheduled by Zoe — job https://ci.internal/nightly/1965432345 (status: queued) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Miguel: For the quant tests, let's capture per-layer activation stats and log a few generations for manual inspection. If q4 shows deterministic length truncation we might need to change outlier handling.
Aya: I'll add failing samples and expand the eval tolerance to accept whitespace-insensitive matches for the short term so product doesn't spike alerts.
Dan: Good temporary mitigation. Long term we need a strict tokenization compatibility check in the model bring-up playbook so tokenizer + quant changes don't merge together.
Priya: Agreed — adding a gating check: run core prompt set with v11 tokenizer and v12 tokenizer diff and require zero offset regressions before promoting.
Zoe: Patch is ready, uploading now. Will report back when nightly finishes. :thumbsup:
Aya: Thanks all. I'll open the regression ticket with attached diffs and mark P1 for triage until the CI rerun lands.
Miguel: Thanks — keeping this thread for updates.
Zoe: Update: nightly rerun finished, initial pass rate recovered from -8% to -0.5% after tokenizer rollback. Quant still needs deeper pass.
Priya: Great, closing the urgent part. We'll follow up on quant next week.
